elements.name: Game
elements.description: Root state record of the whole board game: players, scores, remaining meeples, turn order, the pending tile, the tile grid, the meeple placement dict and the draw stack. Owned by Types.Game; behavior (initialization, turn advance) lives in the same module.

annotations: constant playerLimit = 5 (src/Types/Game.elm:43-45)
each player starts with 7 meeples (src/Types/Game.elm:61)

elements.name: Tile
elements.description: A physical Carcassonne tile: identity, current rotation (degrees, +90 per counter-clockwise turn) and the four cardinal sides plus an optional cloister (Mönch) side.

annotations: sideId -1 marks a field-only side (no feature boundary) — see TileMapper tiles, e.g. src/Helpers/TileMapper.elm:17

elements.name: Side
elements.description: One edge of a tile: a globally-unique feature identifier (sideId, -1 for open field) and the kind of feature (City/Road/Field).

elements.name: TileId
elements.description: Newtype over Int identifying a tile variant in the 24-tile base set (0..23).

elements.name: SideId
elements.description: Newtype over Int used as the global identifier of a connected feature (road/city/field/cloister chain) across the tile grid; -1 denotes an unconnected field side.

elements.name: TileGrid
elements.description: The board: a dictionary from grid coordinates to placed tiles (1..* tiles).

elements.name: PlayerScores
elements.description: Running score per player.

elements.name: Meeples
elements.description: All meeples currently on the board, keyed by feature SideId to the list of meeples placed on that feature (0..* meeples per feature).

elements.name: Meeple
elements.description: A placed meeple: its owner's player index, the tile coordinate it sits on and the position on that tile (center for cloisters, cardinal for sides, Skip = no placement).

annotations: meepleColorDictionary maps player index 0..4 to red/blue/green/yellow/black (src/Types/Meeple.elm:26-34)
record comment reserves room for expansion meeple types (src/Types/Meeple.elm:22)

elements.name: MeeplePosition
elements.description: Custom type with the six possible placements of a meeple on the last placed tile.

annotations: Center is used for cloister tiles (src/Helpers/GameLogic.elm:412-413)

elements.name: Feature
elements.description: Custom type with the four feature kinds a tile side can carry.

elements.name: GameState
elements.description: Custom type driving the per-turn state machine: place tile -> place meeple -> finished.

elements.name: Coordinate
elements.description: Newtype over an (Int, Int) grid coordinate; (0,0) is the starting tile.

elements.name: PlayerIndex
elements.description: Newtype over Int: positional index of a player in Game.players (also the Meeple.owner).

elements.name: PlayerName
elements.description: Newtype over String: the player's display name, used as key in score/meeple dicts and in lobby state.

elements.name: Score
elements.description: Newtype over Int: points accumulated by a player.

elements.name: FrontendModel
elements.description: Lamdera frontend state machine: which screen the local client is on (registration form, lobby, game) and its per-screen data. Mirrored by the Lamdera app model in Frontend.elm.

elements.name: BackendModel
elements.description: Lamdera backend state machine: either the lobby is open (player registration list) or a game is in progress (full Game state).

annotations: alias Model = BackendModel (src/Backend.elm:14-15)

elements.name: FrontendMsg
elements.description: Client-side user intents of the Elm architecture loop; update maps them to local state changes or ToBackend requests, and the views produce them from Html events.

elements.name: ToBackend
elements.description: Requests a client sends to the backend over the Lamdera protocol (sendToBackend); the wire-facing half of a game move or lobby action.

elements.name: BackendMsg
elements.description: Backend-internal messages: client connection notifications and shuffled tile-draw-stack results (from Random.generate / Lamdera.onConnect).

elements.name: ToFrontend
elements.description: Responses the backend broadcasts/sends to clients (sendToFrontend / broadcast): lobby updates and full game-state pushes.

elements.name: GameLogic
elements.description: Core game-rule service (module Helpers.GameLogic). Owns all pure domain behavior on Game: tile rotation, rotation validation, tile placement with feature (sideId) merging, meeple placement with scoring of finished features, and end-of-game scoring. No I/O; fully testable.

cities larger than 2 tiles score double when finished mid-game (src/Helpers/GameLogic.elm:430-432)
players start with 7 meeples (set in initializeGame, src/Types/Game.elm:61); placing a non-Skip meeple decrements the count (src/Helpers/GameLogic.elm:493-500)

elements.name: TileMapper
elements.description: Tile-catalog service (module Helpers.TileMapper): maps each TileId 0..23 to its canonical Tile (sides, features, cloister); unknown ids fall back to tile 0. The 24 tiles define the base-set composition.

annotations: only tiles 3 and 4 carry a cloister (src/Helpers/TileMapper.elm:49,59)
fallthrough _ -> getTile 0 (src/Helpers/TileMapper.elm:252-253)
module exposes only getTile (src/Helpers/TileMapper.elm:1)

elements.name: FrontendHelpers
elements.description: Gameplay-feasibility service (module Helpers.FrontendHelpers): computes where the current tile can legally be placed, where a meeple may go, and draws the next playable tile from the draw stack. Shared by the Backend (draw stack) and the GameView (highlighting of legal moves).

elements.name: Backend
elements.description: Lamdera backend controller (module Backend). The single source of truth for the shared game state; applies ToBackend requests through GameLogic/FrontendHelpers and broadcasts state to all clients. Also owns lobby management (register/kick/kill, 5-player limit) and tile-draw-stack shuffling via Random.

elements.name: Evergreen Lamdera state snapshots (V1/V3/V5/V10)
elements.description: Compiler-generated Lamdera Evergreen snapshot copies of the live types (FrontendModel/BackendModel/FrontendMsg/ToBackend/BackendMsg/ToFrontend plus the Game/Tile/Meeple/Feature/GameState/Coordinate/PlayerName subtrees) at versions V1, V3, V5, V10, with per-version migration stubs in Evergreen.Migrate. They mirror current types (see the generation header at src/Evergreen/Migrate/V10.elm:3) and exist for Lamdera state-versioning/migration, so they are modeled as one group rather than individual classes. Note: the V10 snapshot carries extra constructors not present in the live types (FrontendMsg.ClearError at src/Evergreen/V10/Types.elm:47, BackendMsg.NoOpBackendMsg at src/Evergreen/V10/Types.elm:66), confirming they are frozen snapshots rather than the live definitions.

elements.name: Game contains TileGrid
elements.description: Composition: Game holds exactly one TileGrid (its board).

elements.name: TileGrid contains Tile
elements.description: Composition: TileGrid is a Dict from Coordinate to Tile, so a board holds 1..* placed tiles (starts with the single (0,0) tile).

elements.name: Game contains Meeples
elements.description: Composition: Game holds exactly one Meeples dictionary of placed meeples.

elements.name: Meeples aggregates Meeple
elements.description: Aggregation: Meeples maps feature SideIds to lists of Meeple (0..* per feature; empty dict at game start).

elements.name: Tile contains Side
elements.description: Composition: every Tile owns exactly four Side values (north, east, south, west).

elements.name: Tile optionally contains cloister SideId
elements.description: Optional composition: Tile.cloister is Maybe SideId — 0..1 cloister side (tiles 3 and 4 in the base set).

elements.name: Side references Feature
elements.description: Composition: each Side carries one Feature describing what borders that edge.

elements.name: Meeple owned by PlayerIndex
elements.description: Association: Meeple.owner references the positional index of its owner in Game.players.

elements.name: Meeple placed at Coordinate
elements.description: Association: Meeple.coordinates references the tile coordinate it sits on (set to Game.lastPlacedTile at placement).

gaps: Elm has no inheritance/hierarchy — no inheritance relationships were modeled or invented; the closest structural relationships are record composition (field types) and module dependencies (imports).

Elm has no visibility system; everything a module exports is public. All attributes/methods are therefore marked '+' (GameLogic/TileMapper/FrontendHelpers export everything via 'exposing (..)'; TileMapper exports only getTile, Frontend exports only Model and app).

The planner named 'isTilePlacementValid' and 'getMeeplePositions' — no functions with those exact names exist; the realized equivalents are FrontendHelpers.tileCanBePlaced / tileCanBePlacedAnywhere (src/Helpers/FrontendHelpers.elm:48,120) and FrontendHelpers.getMeeplePositionsToBePlacedOn (src/Helpers/FrontendHelpers.elm:27).

There is no independent data-access layer: the Lamdera backend (Backend.elm) is the shared authoritative state and the frontend keeps a full copy of Game for rendering; state sync happens via the ToBackend/ToFrontend protocol, not a repository. Layer names reflect this (controller = Backend/Frontend, service = rule modules, no data-access tier exists).

Tile side-merging on placement is handled by SideId rewriting (replaceTileSideId) rather than explicit feature-graph objects; the 'feature' abstraction is the SideId int across tiles, so a dedicated Feature-graph class does not exist to model.
Evergreen snapshot details (per-version type shapes) were not individually inventoried; the group entry (CL-32) covers them as compiler-generated mirrors, per the scope note.
